SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT '01_PO' AS DOC_NAME , SO06.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO AS ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ AS ORDR_SEQ , SO06.ORDR_NO AS KEY_1 , SO06.ORDR_SEQ AS KEY_2 , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ , 'N' AS IS_HEAD FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06 WHERE SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD = 'SS03' AND SO06.SND_CHK = 'N' UNION SELECT '02_RS' AS DOC_NAME , SO06.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO AS ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ AS ORDR_SEQ , RS02.DLVRY_PLAN_NO AS KEY_1 , RS02.DLVRY_PLAN_SEQ AS KEY_2 , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ , 'N' AS IS_HEAD FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPPO02 PO02, KEPMPRS02 RS02 WHERE SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD = 'SS03' AND PO02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = PO02.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_NO = PO02.ORDR_NO AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = PO02.ORDR_SEQ AND RS02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND PO02.PLCORD_NO = RS02.PLCORD_NO AND PO02.PLCORD_SEQ= RS02.PLCORD_SEQ AND RS02.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND RS02.SND_CHK = 'N' UNION SELECT '03_IV' AS DOC_NAME , SO06.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO AS ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ AS ORDR_SEQ , SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AS KEY_1 , SV02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ AS KEY_2 , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ , DECODE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SV01.CSTMR_ID,SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO ORDER BY SV01.CSTMR_ID,SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO,SV02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ DESC),1,'Y','N') AS IS_HEAD FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPMPSV02 SV02 WHERE SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND SV01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SV01.SND_CHK = 'Z' AND SV01.CSTMR_ID = SO06.CSTMR_ID AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = SV02.ORDR_NO AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = SV02.ORDR_SEQ AND SV02.SND_CHK = 'Z' UNION SELECT '04_DI' AS DOC_NAME , SO06.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO AS ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ AS ORDR_SEQ , DE02.SHP_NO AS KEY_1 , DE02.SHP_SEQ AS KEY_2 , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ , DECODE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DE01.CSTMR_ID,DE02.SHP_NO ORDER BY DE01.CSTMR_ID,DE02.SHP_NO,DE02.SHP_SEQ DESC),1,'Y','N') AS IS_HEAD FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPMPSV02 SV02, KEPWMDE02 DE02, KEPWMDE01 DE01 WHERE SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND SV01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SV01.CSTMR_ID = SO06.CSTMR_ID AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.ORDR_NO = SV02.ORDR_NO AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = SV02.ORDR_SEQ AND DE02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO = DE02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ= DE02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ AND DE02.SND_CHK = 'N' AND DE01.CSTMR_ID = SO06.CSTMR_ID AND DE01.SHP_NO = DE02.SHP_NO AND DE01.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND DE01.SND_CHK = 'N' UNION SELECT '05_GR' AS DOC_NAME , SO06.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO AS ORDR_NO , SO06.ORDR_SEQ AS ORDR_SEQ , GR02.CSTMR_STCKAG_NO AS KEY_1 , GR02.CSTMR_STCKAG_SEQ AS KEY_2 , SO06.IF_ORDR_NO , SO06.IF_ORDR_SEQ , 'N' AS IS_HEAD FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPGR02 GR02 WHERE SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND GR02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.CSTMR_ID = GR02.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_NO = GR02.ORDR_NO AND SO06.ORDR_SEQ = GR02.ORDR_SEQ AND GR02.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND GR02.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY DOC_NAME, ORDR_NO,ORDR_SEQ
